items.title: Verify eight-pig Sounders in production
items.summary: The client and production database raised the Sounder membership ceiling from four to eight.
checks: Grow a real Sounder beyond four members and confirm all eight roster seats render correctly.
Confirm the eighth pig can join and a ninth invite or knock is rejected with friendly full-copy.
Confirm full eight-pig Sounders disappear from discovery and production logs show no crew_full anomalies before seat eight.

items.title: Run the Expo 57 post-release smoke
items.summary: Build 175 moves the production app from Expo 52 to Expo 57 and React Native 0.76 to 0.86.
checks: Smoke cold launch, auth, background/resume, offline/reconnect, camera, notifications, audio/video, Rive, Skia, and purchases from the App Store binary.
Monitor Sentry and Supabase for new crashes, native-module failures, or silent core-action errors.
Confirm rewarded-ad UI remains dark and record the known missing sticker-extension follow-up separately.

items.title: Verify player digging stories in production
items.summary: A new authenticated player-profile page aggregates lifetime Truffle Patch digs, credited finds, freed motes, and Sounder bonuses.
checks: Open your own digging story and compare all four totals with submitted production rootings.
Open another pig's digging story and confirm the profile-to-page handoff, zero state, and block privacy.
Complete a Truffle Patch with shimmer and a Sounder bonus, then confirm the totals rise after returning to the page.

items.title: Verify the Nitro-based Rive runtime in production

checks: Open a bundled Rive pig animation on a physical iPhone and confirm it renders and responds
Open the Mote Machine and confirm mote, payout, reduceMotion, and spin ViewModel bindings work
Check production crash reporting for RiveRuntime, RNRive, or NitroModules failures

items.title: Verify Mote Alchemy in production
items.summary: Adds spendable Mote balances, shimmer credits, an idempotent server-selected alchemy reward RPC, recipe controls, a possible zero-Tickle result, and the Rive-powered player flow.
checks: Confirm submitted shimmer credits exactly one Mote
Confirm one reaction spends exactly one Mote and grants the displayed Tickles, including a zero-Tickle result
Confirm Warmth, Whirl, and Resonance values reach the receipt and do not guarantee a reward
Confirm repeated full-motion and Reduced Motion reactions on a public-store build
Review Mote Alchemy RPC errors and reward receipts after release

items.title: Verify weekly Dig-Off tickle auto-application
items.summary: Weekly season-digging tickle spoils now increase applied tickle counters directly instead of entering the spendable bank; tegdirb and briguy receive a one-time full ordinary-bank conversion.
checks: Confirm tegdirb and briguy's ordinary banks were emptied and their counters rose by the transferred balances
Complete a weekly Dig-Off payout and confirm awarded tickles increase counter and tickles_earned without increasing item_count
Confirm weekly payout receipts and announcements still show the awarded tickle amount

items.title: Verify Barn tickle performance in production
items.summary: Core tickles now use cached session identity, immediate local reservations on poor connections, mutation-response reconciliation, coalesced home-state reads, throttled pass-event polling, and batched particle commits; the exact shipped binary needs real-device responsiveness and state-consistency checks.
checks: Rapidly tickle Rosie on a physical iPhone and confirm animation, audio, haptics, and counters stay responsive
Repeat a five-tickle burst at roughly 2.5 seconds RTT with Network Link Conditioner and confirm feedback is immediate, only five mutations start, and a dropped response rolls back then reconciles
Spend a full tickle bank quickly and confirm READY TO TICKLE, TICKLES EARNED, Snouts, happiness mood, and lucky bonuses reconcile correctly after the burst
Background and foreground the app after rapid tickling and confirm home stats and pass-event notices refresh without stale or duplicate UI
Compare Sentry/network telemetry for home_stats, unseen_pass_events, and auth user reads against the previous public build

items.title: Verify independent Hat and Bow equipment

checks: Confirm a pre-release bow wearer kept the same bow after upgrade
Equip and unequip Hat and Bow independently on two devices
Verify Hat plus Bow render together in Barn, Closet preview, item preview, and barn visits

items.title: Verify Sluggish Snout regeneration accounting
items.summary: Regeneration now preserves fractional progress and integrates rate changes across Sluggish Snout start, cleanse, blessing cancellation, and natural expiry without refunding suppressed Tickles.
checks: Start Sluggish Snout on a partially regenerated account and confirm the slowdown applies from the current fractional percentage
Cleanse or cancel a blessing and confirm no catch-up Tickles appear
Let Sluggish Snout expire naturally and confirm the countdown resumes from the preserved fraction

items.title: Verify recurring Feeding notifications in production
items.summary: Adds an account-synchronized recurring Feeding preference and a server cron dispatcher with participation gates and per-window deduplication.

Tap the push and confirm it opens the Season Truffle Patch surface
Disable the preference and confirm later Feedings stay silent
Confirm crewless and already-dug accounts are suppressed
Review cron, delivery-ledger, and pg_net results for misses or duplicates

items.title: Verify preset Sounder messaging in production

Confirm each message appears once in the next-active digest, is marked shown only on dismissal, and remains in notification-board history
Use Invite + Oink as a leader and confirm the recruiting message is tied to the real pending invite
Confirm nonleaders, blocked users, invalid state, and duplicate per-Feeding sends are rejected
Confirm this in-app messaging path emits no OS push

Confirm 1-day and 1-week Auto-Tickler activation costs and active windows

Open the achievement digest and Achievements page, then equip the Unmissable title
If the commuter schedule is activated, confirm the opening-at-week-boundary rule produces 28 eligible Feedings without double-counting the prior week's open window

Verify local feeding push timing, cross-zone Sounder bonuses and 21-Feeding weekly perfect-Feeding awards
Verify compatible-client adoption resolves older countdown mismatches, unregistered Eastern fallback and initial timezone deferral; confirm three daily Feedings with existing reward amounts
Check the September 7 transition cycle's legacy snapshots and perfect-Feeding award limitations, then verify the first full local-schedule week
